text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًۭا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

words.gloss_range: deictic demonstrative with plural addressee suffix pointing to a settled verdict and introducing its cause
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكُم}} ({{tr:dhālikum}}) does not begin with a fresh charge; it points to the prior verdict (45:34) as an already fixed matter while its plural suffix keeps the condemned addressees attached to that verdict. The word also leans forward, making the rest of the clause read as the explanation of why that sentence stands.

topics.headline: plural address fastens the verdict to them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verdict is not abstract; the distant demonstrative is grammatically aimed at the same plural audience.
topics.reason: The suffix is parsed as plural address, and the surrounding causal clause keeps the same addressees in view.

topics.headline: demonstrative gathers verdict and opens cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah explains a sentence already pronounced in 45:34 rather than launching an independent accusation.
topics.reason: The deictic opening refers back to the prior verdict (45:34) and is immediately followed by a causal complement.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition functioning as the causal hinge into the governed fact-clause
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that turns the following content into the verdict's ground. It binds consequence to conduct, so the punishment is presented as grammatically warranted rather than left as an unexplained outcome.

topics.headline: causal attachment to the fact-clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the misconduct is not background information but the governed basis of the verdict.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the particle as governing the following fact-clause, with causal force in the local frame.

words.gloss_range: annulling fact-clause marker with plural addressee suffix, making the following misconduct a governed cause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّكُمُ}} ({{tr:annakumu}}) turns the following actions into stated causal content while preserving direct plural address. Before the two failures are narrated, the suffix has already identified the responsible group.

topics.headline: misconduct as governed fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mockery and delusion entering the syntax as adjudicable cause, not rumor or loose description.
topics.reason: The annulling particle is governed by the prefixed preposition, and its clause supplies the causal content.

topics.headline: addressees named before both failures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that responsibility is assigned to the plural group before the two completed causal verbs unfold.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix precedes both past verbs in the embedded causal sequence.

words.gloss_range: completed second-person plural adoption/reclassification in a two-object frame
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, and adopting range; the local Form VIII-like frame selects adopting or taking-as, with seizure pressure only as a controlled image
words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ}} ({{tr:ittakhadhtum}}) makes ridicule a chosen reclassification: the signs are the object and mockery is the status assigned to them. The root {{ar:أ خ ذ}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-dh}}) can carry stronger taking or seizure pressure, but this local frame narrows it to adopting something as a role or stance, as though the signs' evidentiary function is captured and forced into derision. Its perfect form also places that stance in the completed past before today's consequence, and the same taking-signs-as-ridicule pattern echoes earlier warning and the surah-local misclassifications of signs as ridicule and desire as deity (2:231; 45:9; 45:23).

topics.headline: two-object adoption assigns a status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that they did not merely laugh at signs; they made divine signs occupy the category of ridicule.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a transitive two-object or object-complement frame, with the perfect second-person verb as the first causal action.

topics.headline: taking image narrowed to adopted stance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the force of taking or capture while seeing that local grammar selects interpretive adoption rather than physical seizure.
topics.reason: The broader root range supports taking and seizing imagery, but the local object-complement construction constrains the active sense to adopting-as.

topics.headline: warning formula returns as verdict evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 45:35 as the verdict-stage of a recurring false-adoption pattern, including the warning in 2:231 and the surah-local contrast with 45:23.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete recurrence points for taking signs as ridicule (2:231; 45:9) and for false adoption inside the surah (45:23).

words.gloss_range: plural construct object naming divine signs, verses, proofs, and indicators before their derisive reclassification
words.root_gloss_range: sign, verse, proof, and portent range; local construct and object role select divine indicators, while derivational return/refuge pressure remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:āyāti}}) is fully specified as divine signs before the degrading status arrives. The plural makes a whole class of indications visible, and the root {{ar:أ ي ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-y-y}}) keeps sign, proof, verse, and portent breadth active while any derivational return/refuge pressure stays secondary to the local object of divine communication. Its recurrence with ridicule sharpens the reversal: disclosure that should point to truth is made unserious (41:53; 45:9).

topics.headline: divine signs faced before ridicule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader faces the dignity of the object before hearing what the addressees made it into.
topics.reason: The noun is the object of the adoption verb and is completed by the genitive divine name before the complement of ridicule appears.

topics.headline: plural sign range with secondary return pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offense covers divine indication as a class, while derivational return/refuge pressure remains secondary to the local sign/proof sense.
topics.reason: The plural and lexical range support sign, verse, proof, and portent breadth; contested derivational pressure can color but not replace the local object sense.

topics.headline: signs-ridicule recurrence sharpens reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase as a repeated Quranic/surah-local pattern where signs presented for truth are reclassified as ridicule (41:53; 45:9).
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect the local object with disclosure in 41:53 and the same-surah ridicule pattern in 45:9.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive construct, fixing the signs as belonging to the named divine authority
words.root_gloss_range: worship and ultimate-orientation range around the divine name; local grammar uses the proper name as genitive possessor
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) completes the construct before ridicule is named, so the mocked object is not anonymous evidence but signs belonging to the named divine authority. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) carries worship and ultimate-orientation pressure, but local grammar uses the proper name as genitive possessor. That placement makes the drop into mockery sharper and links the charge with broader mockery of God and His signs (9:65).

topics.headline: proper name fixes ownership before mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mockery touches signs precisely as God's owned communication, not neutral material.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the proper name the genitive complement of the construct object.

topics.headline: worship-orientation pressure kept under proper-name grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the ultimate-orientation force of the divine name while recognizing that the local job is genitive possession.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute can intensify the phrase, but the local parse is the proper divine name completing the construct.

topics.headline: mockery field names the divine target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the local phrase inside a larger polemic where God and His signs are treated as objects of mockery (9:65).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give 9:65 as a concrete parallel for God, signs, and mockery in one field.

words.gloss_range: accusative verbal noun functioning as the assigned status of ridicule or derisive unseriousness
words.root_gloss_range: mockery, contempt, and unserious play range; the local masdar makes derision an imposed category rather than a passing act
words.prose: {{ar:هُزُوًۭا}} ({{tr:huzuwan}}) is not a loose insult; as a verbal noun governed by the adoption verb, it becomes the status under which the signs are filed. The root {{ar:ه ز أ}} ({{tr:h-z-ʾ}}) supplies contemptuous play and clipped dismissal, while qiraat-related sound pressure can be kept as a secondary texture rather than the main parse. The word closes the first causal beat by revealing the degradation after the divine object has been fully named, and it recalls the signs-as-ridicule field (18:106; 45:9).

topics.headline: mockery as assigned object-status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ridicule as an imposed category for the signs, not merely a passing emotional reaction.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as the accusative complement of the adoption verb.

topics.headline: hamza texture kept as secondary sound payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a clipped contempt texture, while the local grammatical payoff remains the verbal noun of mockery.
topics.reason: The qiraat and phonetic rows support acoustic texture, but they do not override the local gerund complement function.

topics.headline: known ridicule formula returns in final cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local status-word with a broader divine-communication mockery pattern (18:106; 45:9).
topics.reason: The supplied rows name 18:106 and 45:9 as concrete recurrence points for signs or messengers treated as ridicule.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the worldly-delusion clause inside the same causal ground
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the next verb inside the same causal frame. It adds worldly delusion as a second ground beside chosen mockery, so susceptibility is not allowed to erase agency.

topics.headline: chosen mockery and delusion joined as grounds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees agency and susceptibility held together as one explanatory complex for the verdict.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second perfect verb with the first under the same governed causal clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect transitive deception verb with the addressees as direct object and worldly life as feminine subject
words.root_gloss_range: lure, delusion, and hazardous exposure range; local grammar makes worldly life the direct deceiving agent
words.prose: {{ar:غَرَّتْكُمُ}} ({{tr:gharratkumu}}) makes the addressees the direct object of deception while the following life-phrase is the feminine subject. The root {{ar:غ ر ر}} ({{tr:gh-r-r}}) adds lure and hazardous false appearance, so near-life is not scenery but an active deceptive force. The completed verb also turns earlier warnings against being deceived by worldly life into historical evidence for judgment (31:33; 35:5).

topics.headline: worldly life acts on the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that life-near is the grammatical deceiver and the accused group are its affected object.
topics.reason: Agreement, word order, and attachment evidence identify the following life phrase as subject and the suffix as direct object.

topics.headline: deception as attractive hazardous exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deception as lure through false appearance, not mere intellectual error.
topics.reason: The root field supports delusion, lure, and risk, and the local phrase names worldly life as the agent of that action.

topics.headline: warnings become completed deception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears earlier warnings not to be deceived by worldly life fulfilled as a completed causal fact (31:33; 35:5).
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the local completed verb with warning passages in 31:33 and 35:5.

words.gloss_range: definite life-domain functioning as the subject of deception and narrowed by the following worldly adjective
words.root_gloss_range: life, vitality, and lived reality range; local phrase selects the nearer life as an incentive-environment that deceives
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}) is the named subject of the deception, not life in every sense but the definite life-domain narrowed by its adjective. The root {{ar:ح ي ي}} ({{tr:ḥ-y-y}}) keeps vitality and lived reality in view, while the local phrase shows that living reality can become a misleading incentive-system when treated as ultimate. That makes the surah's earlier worldly-life claim return as the deceiver (45:24), with the true-life contrast in 29:64 sharpening the loss.

topics.headline: abstract life becomes deceiving subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an abstract life-domain is grammatically promoted into the agent that captured perception.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the definite life noun the subject of the deception verb and the head modified by the following adjective.

topics.headline: vitality narrowed into lesser life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verse does not condemn life as such; it exposes the nearer life as false finality against true life (29:64).
topics.reason: The lexical rows keep vitality and true-life contrast available while the adjective narrows the local phrase to worldly life.

topics.headline: earlier life-claim returns as deception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the deceiving life-domain with the earlier claim that only worldly life matters (45:24).
topics.reason: The supplied echo rows explicitly connect 45:24 with the life phrase in 45:35.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine adjective qualifying life as the nearer or lower domain that deceives
words.root_gloss_range: nearness and lowness range; local adjective role evaluates the life-domain relative to a higher and lasting horizon
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:ad-dunyā}}) is the adjective that tells which life deceived: the nearer, lower life. The root {{ar:د ن و}} ({{tr:d-n-w}}) makes that label relational, so worldly life is judged by proximity and rank rather than treated as absolute. By closing the causal beat on this word, the ayah lets preference for the short horizon meet the decisive day that follows, a contrast also visible in 87:16-17.

topics.headline: fixed worldly-life modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deceiver is not life generically but life qualified as the nearer/lower domain.
topics.reason: Agreement and attachment evidence parse the word as the adjective qualifying the life noun.

topics.headline: nearness and lowness judge the lure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the life-domain deceives: it offers immediacy while ranking below the lasting horizon.
topics.reason: The comparative/superlative lexical field supports nearness and lowness, and the local adjective role applies that evaluation to life.

topics.headline: dunyā meets judgment-day horizon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the word's short horizon with the contrast between preferred worldly life and the lasting afterlife (87:16-17).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide 87:16-17 and the local pivot to judgment-time as concrete horizon contrasts.

words.gloss_range: resultive conjunction fused to the time adverb, moving from causal archive to enacted consequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) converts the completed causes into the consequence-stage. Attached to the time word, it makes judgment-time arrive before either denied action is named, and it also marks the register shift from direct accusation to reported final closure.

topics.headline: past causes become present consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact pivot where explanation stops and enacted consequence begins.
topics.reason: QAC treats the particle as prefixed to the time adverb, and the clause sequence moves from governed causes to result.

topics.headline: address shifts into reported final sentence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the condemned addressees move from directly confronted speakers into a described group under final consequence.
topics.reason: The boundary row tracks the discourse shift at the result particle before the third-person passive clauses.

words.gloss_range: fronted definite accusative time adverb scoping the paired denials
words.root_gloss_range: day, appointed time, and decisive event-window range; local fronting makes judgment-time govern both closures
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) is fronted before both denials, so the day itself becomes the governing frame for no release and no appeasement. The root {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) here is event-time, not calendar duration: the decisive window when past interpretation becomes enforced reality. Its repetition from the previous verdict (45:34) makes one judgment-time carry abandonment, enclosure, and no repair.

topics.headline: decisive time scopes both denials
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that time is established before the blocked actions, making the day the arena of both closures.
topics.reason: The accusative time adverb is fronted before the two negated passive clauses.

topics.headline: day as decisive event-window
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the day as an arrived judgment event, not a neutral date.
topics.reason: The definite adverbial noun and lexical field support appointed event-time in the local judgment frame.

topics.headline: one today links 45:34 and 45:35
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same today in 45:34 and 45:35 tightening, not reopening, the verdict.
topics.reason: The supplied rows explicitly connect the today of reciprocal forgetting in 45:34 with the no-release/no-appeal consequences in 45:35.

words.gloss_range: first negative particle blocking the passive extraction event
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the closure pattern by negating the extraction event itself. It does not merely deny desire or intention; it blocks the passive release before the second negation adds another denied route.

topics.headline: first no blocks extraction as event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees release denied as an event before any separate question of appeasement is raised.
topics.reason: QAC places the negative particle before the passive imperfect, and the attachment profile makes it govern the extraction clause.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect extraction verb under negation, governing a source phrase and denying release from a containing domain
words.root_gloss_range: leaving, emerging, and boundary-crossing range; local passive Form IV-like wording selects caused extraction, with active-voice variant evidence only contrasting agency
words.prose: {{ar:يُخْرَجُونَ}} ({{tr:yukhrajūna}}) is passive extraction under negation: the possible remover is suppressed, and what remains foregrounded is that no being-brought-out occurs. The root {{ar:خ ر ج}} ({{tr:kh-r-j}}) makes release a boundary crossing out of enclosure, while the passive form specifies caused extraction. An active-voice reading can contrast self-exit with external removal, but the local aligned form is passive; either way, the boundary remains closed. The denial also answers the prior abode/fire scene (45:34) and contrasts with attempted exit from fire in 32:20.

topics.headline: passive caused removal is denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse denies even externally caused removal, not only self-departure.
topics.reason: QAC aligns the local form as passive imperfect Form IV-like, negated and followed by a source phrase.

topics.headline: variant tests agency, not outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare extraction and self-exit while keeping the local passive parse and the same no-release outcome.
topics.reason: The active reading is useful as contrast for agency, but QAC and local morphology identify the aligned form as passive extraction.

topics.headline: abode becomes no-exit container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior abode/fire statement (45:34) turn into the container from which no exit occurs, with 32:20 as a contrasting exit-from-fire scene.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect 45:34 and 32:20 to the local no-release clause.

words.gloss_range: source prepositional phrase with feminine pronoun, making the denied extraction a movement out of a containing domain
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهَا}} ({{tr:minhā}}) supplies the source-domain for the denied extraction. Its feminine pronoun lets the prior fire or punishment-state function as the containing domain, and by closing the clause after the extraction verb it leaves the listener inside the container. What was called an abode in 45:34 becomes the place from which they are not brought out.

topics.headline: source phrase makes release spatial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no-release is spatialized as failure to cross out from a containing domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the source complement of the denied extraction verb.

topics.headline: clause ending leaves them inside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prior abode/fire scene (45:34) become the interior in which the denial closes.
topics.reason: The source phrase lands at the end of the release clause and the boundary row ties it to the prior abode in 45:34.

words.gloss_range: conjunction before the second negation, adding a distinct remedial denial
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not repeat the first denial; it adds a second denied predicate. The closure widens from blocked release to blocked repair, so spatial escape and relational restoration are both shut.

topics.headline: second closure added, not repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse closes another route after no exit: the route of appeasement or repair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second negative clause with the first, and the following verb names a different process.

words.gloss_range: second negative particle resetting negation over the pronoun-fronted remedial clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) resets negation over the final remedial clause. It keeps appeasement from being swallowed into the no-exit statement, making repair a separately denied channel focused on the same group.

topics.headline: repair denied as its own channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees relational repair closed separately, not merely as a subcase of release.
topics.reason: QAC places this negative particle before a pronoun-fronted passive clause, and the repeated negation distinguishes the second denial.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun fronted under negation, focusing the excluded group before the passive verb
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) is more than recoverable agreement. By standing independently before the final passive verb, it shifts the second denial from an event-centered no to a people-centered exclusion: they are the ones for whom the repair channel is closed.

topics.headline: detached pronoun isolates the excluded group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final denial centering the condemned people themselves before naming the unavailable process.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is not needed for verbal agreement, so its fronted position adds focus under negation.

words.gloss_range: passive Form X imperfect denying admission into appeasement or restoration from blame
words.root_gloss_range: reproach, satisfaction, appeasement, and return from blame range; local Form X passive selects denied remedial seeking
words.prose: {{ar:يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yustaʿtabūn}}) closes the ayah with no admitted process of appeasement. The passive Form X shape makes the group patients of a restoration channel that never opens, while the root {{ar:ع ت ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-t-b}}) spans reproach, satisfaction, and movement back from blame. Its rarity and final position specialize the ending: after no exit, and after the opening reclassification of signs as ridicule, there is no accepted route to make blame right, a judgment formula also seen in 16:84 and 30:57.

topics.headline: passive Form X closes repair process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a different door closed from physical exit: no channel opens for satisfying blame or being restored.
topics.reason: QAC aligns the local form as passive Form X imperfect under negation, and the lexical field supports appeasement/restoration from blame.

topics.headline: judgment formula and ayah envelope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final no-appeasement wording with judgment contexts in 16:84 and 30:57 and with the ayah's opening reclassification.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly cite 16:84 and 30:57 for the same no-appeasement formula and read the opening-to-closing semantic envelope.

topics.headline: paired passive cadence binds the two denials
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two final passive plurals as paired closures: no extraction and no appeasement.
topics.reason: The phonetic row connects the shared plural passive cadence of the two final denied verbs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 3-6 make God's signs the object of a taking construction whose assigned predicate is ridicule.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction is active and functional: evidentiary markers oriented toward worship are acquired and reassigned a contrary social use. The failure is therefore not mere inattention but deliberate semiotic repurposing.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies deliberate appropriation and the power to assign a new use.
A publicly legible marker supplies the evidentiary object that is being appropriated.
The worship relation fixes the signs' proper orientation and thereby sharpens the inversion.
Ridicule supplies the imposed social use that reverses the markers' evidentiary and devotional force.

changed_reading.before: They failed to respect God's signs.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately appropriated evidentiary markers and assigned them the social function of ridicule, reversing their worship-oriented use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 7-9 make proximate life the grammatical deceiver.
baseline_models.mechanism: Immediate life offers real benefit, but proximity and attractive surface are mistaken for completeness and durability. Its credibility comes from genuine usefulness; its deception lies in allowing the nearest horizon to claim exclusive explanatory priority.

activation_trace.role: An attractive but unstable surface supplies the lure that falsely presents itself as sufficient and durable.
Life understood as benefit and good supplies the real utility that makes the lure credible rather than wholly fictive.
Nearness supplies the attentional advantage of what is immediately available over what is remote.

changed_reading.after: Immediate benefit gained epistemic priority because proximity and surface appeal were mistaken for completeness and durability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal pivot at focus word 10 leads to coordinated denials of extraction at word 12 and restored acceptance at word 16.
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive event closes two routes at once: movement out of an enclosing state and the social-procedural route by which blame might be removed and acceptance recovered. The focus alone leaves the enclosure's referent underspecified.

activation_trace.role: A day understood as a grave event supplies a phase change rather than a neutral calendar label.
Passage from a state or place to its outside supplies the release that is categorically denied.

changed_reading.before: They remain punished and are not allowed to apologize.
changed_reading.after: The decisive event closes both release from an enclosing state and the procedural recovery of acceptance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same marker vocabulary spans the visible cosmos, recited discourse, and an earlier taking-to-ridicule construction. The focus accusation therefore names a transferable evidence-handling practice: heterogeneous disclosures are flattened into an unserious category before they can demand response.

activation_trace.role: The visible-marker sense anchors the focus object as evidence rather than a merely verbal token.
Deliberate acquisition supplies the stable handling operation applied to that evidence.
A marker visible in the cosmic setting broadens the evidence beyond recited language.
The two marker occurrences in a recitation setting add a verbally delivered evidence channel.
An earlier act of making the signs into something for oneself supplies a repeated appropriation pattern.
The earlier ridicule occurrence confirms the same imposed response category before the focus restatement.

structural_cues: The marker root recurs in cosmic, creaturely, recited, learned, and courtroom positions before the focus accusation repeats the taking-to-ridicule syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence across evidence channels and the repeated taking-to-ridicule construction; I infer one transferable suppression practice. A live alternative is cumulative culpability without a unified handling mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They converted God's signs into ridicule.
changed_reading.after: They used ridicule as a stable suppression practice that reclassified materially visible and verbally recited evidence alike before it could make a claim on them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first presents observable reanimation after death as a sign, then quotes a creed that admits living and dying while enclosing both within proximate life and extended time. Worldly deception is thus not denial of the observed cycle but closure of a true cycle into a self-sufficient ontology that excludes source, gathering, and judgment.

activation_trace.role: The unstable lure supplies the false claim of sufficiency imposed on otherwise real life processes.
Proximity supplies the boundary within which the admitted cycle is treated as exhaustive.
Earth's recovery through rain and growth supplies a concrete, observable return of vitality.
Loss of vitality supplies the prior state from which the observable recovery proceeds.
Animate existence supplies both occurrences in the quoted life-only account and marks what that account permits as real.
The nearer world supplies the explicit horizon to which the quoted account restricts life.
Extended time supplies the substitute causal frame that contains death without opening onto judgment.

structural_cues: The sequence at 45:5 runs provision to reanimation after death; 45:24 closes living and dying inside time, while 45:26 reopens the sequence toward gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a witnessed renewal cycle, the quoted life-only claim, and the later gathering sequence; I infer that deception consists in closing rather than fabricating the cycle. Alternatively, the focus may denote attachment to pleasures without this epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Near life deceived them through pleasure and distraction.
changed_reading.after: Near life deceived them by turning a genuine renewal pattern into a closed explanation: life and death were admitted, but source, gathering, and judgment were excluded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near and conspicuous acquires control of attention while hearing fails to become understanding and perceptual channels are sealed. Deception becomes an architecture of selective uptake: signs remain available, but foreground salience prevents them from reaching responsive judgment until hidden consequences become visible.

activation_trace.role: A conspicuous bright mark supplies the visual salience by which surface prominence captures attention.
Spatial and cognitive nearness supplies the foreground advantage of immediate life.
The signs remain overt markers, making the problem failed uptake rather than missing evidence.
Hearing as comprehension and response makes the paired hearing and as-if-not-hearing sequence a failed uptake channel.
A secured barrier supplies closure of the inward channels through which evidence would become responsive judgment.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the perceptual faculty whose availability does not guarantee insight.

structural_cues: At 45:23 hearing, heart, and sight are blocked in one sequence; at 45:33 the concealed consequences of deeds become apparent, reversing the earlier visibility regime.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, conspicuousness, overt signs, failed hearing, and sealed faculties; I infer an attention-capture mechanism. A live alternative is simple willful refusal with no special role for perceptual foregrounding.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life told them something false.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life captured the foreground: what was near and conspicuous monopolized uptake while overt signs failed to become inwardly effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated taking constructions install objects into governing roles: substitute patrons are adopted, inclination is installed as deity, and signs are assigned ridicule. The focus act can therefore be read as part of a rival allegiance system in which desire determines the status of evidence and demotes whatever challenges it.

activation_trace.role: Making something one's own supplies the focus act of installing a chosen relation to the signs.
Ridicule supplies the demoted role assigned to evidence that contests the chosen authority.
A context act of adoption supplies a parallel role-assignment construction involving substitute patrons.
Protective allegiance supplies the relational office expected from the adopted substitutes.
A second context act of adoption supplies the installation of an inward preference into an authoritative office.
Inclination of the self supplies the internal selector that decides which evidence is honored or demoted.
The worship office spanning the three occurrences makes the adopted inclination's rival authority explicit.

structural_cues: The repeated taking syntax moves through substitute patrons and inclination-as-deity before the focus assigns ridicule to signs; active role assignment later gives way to passive non-release.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel adoption constructions, allegiance, inclination, worship, and ridicule; I infer a network of installed roles rather than unrelated offenses. Alternatively, each construction may be an independent example with no shared allegiance mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They adopted a mocking attitude toward the signs.
changed_reading.after: Making signs into ridicule was an allegiance act: inclination governed classification, substitute patrons promised support, and challenging evidence was demoted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an attempted argument, a summons to an individualized record, recompense, a record that gives evidence, and the copying of acts. The focus's denied restoration follows an evidentiary process; it reads as post-verdict finality rather than refusal to hear an initial defense.

activation_trace.role: The grave event supplies the procedural phase in which ordinary opportunities have ended.
Movement to the outside supplies the denied remedy that would alter the adjudicated state.
A contention meant to prevail supplies the defendants' earlier attempted evidentiary challenge.

A response matched to an act supplies the verdict's act-for-consequence structure.

Transfer of a written image into another record supplies continuity between performed acts and the evidence presented.

structural_cues: The un-inventoried ع ت ب form at focus word 16 is used only through its passive morphology and coordination with non-extraction; no branch is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenge, summons, binding record, matched recompense, testimony, and transcription; I infer procedural closure as the arrow to denied restoration. A live alternative is a nontechnical denial of appeasement after punishment begins.

changed_reading.after: They are denied reopening after argument, summons, record, and matched judgment have already run their course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Agency and spatial relation reverse. People first make signs into an object of ridicule; immediately before the focus, what they ridiculed becomes an encompassing consequence, and a fire-abode is named. The focus then shifts them into passive subjects who cannot be extracted from that enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Active appropriation supplies the initial relation in which people control the signs' assigned use.

Passage to an outside supplies the now-impossible escape from the reversed relation.

The context ridicule occurrence identifies what had been held at a mocking distance before it surrounds them.
Joining a containing refuge or abode supplies the immediately preceding spatial container.
Burning fire identifies the abode and resolves the literal enclosure from which extraction is denied.

structural_cues: At 45:33 the mocked matter becomes the subject of an encompassing verb; 45:34 names fire as abode immediately before the feminine pronoun and passive non-extraction in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ridicule, surrounding harm, fire-abode, and denied exit; I infer a reversal in which the ridiculed evidence returns as enclosing consequence and link the pronoun to the adjacent abode. The live alternative keeps only the local fire antecedent without the conceptual reversal.

changed_reading.after: The relation reverses: what they held off as ridicule becomes an encompassing consequence, and the adjacent fire-abode is the enclosure from which they are not extracted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the near horizon made the future encounter discardable. The immediately preceding reciprocal-neglect formula then turns temporal neglect into relational consequence: at the decisive encounter, release and renewed acceptance are no longer solicited.

Nearness supplies the temporal preference that displaced the remote encounter.
The severe event supplies the moment when deferred relation becomes unavoidable.
The paired event occurrences bind present consequence to the formerly neglected encounter.
Deliberate leaving or neglect across both occurrences supplies the explicit reciprocal relation.
Two parties coming face to face supplies the encounter whose neglect is now reversed.

structural_cues: The explicit comparison at 45:34 pairs present neglect with their prior neglect, and the focus coordinates passive non-extraction with the un-inventoried restoration form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-life lure, paired neglect, encounter, and the decisive event; I infer that denied restoration is the procedural expression of reciprocal abandonment. Alternatively, the comparison may mark retribution without implying relational withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: They cannot regain favor once punishment begins.
changed_reading.after: No restoration is the endpoint of reciprocal neglect: they discarded the future encounter for the near horizon, and the decisive encounter closes their bid for renewed acceptance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote mount-motion branch of the focus ridicule root and links it to the context's harnessed ship movement. It remains anchored in the focus taking-plus-ridicule construction and a coherent context motion sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for instrumentalizing revelation, never as a lexical translation of ridicule.

The remote act of setting a mount in motion supplies the vehicle image for instrumentalized signs.
Subduing and directing something toward a purpose supplies the context's explicit harnessing mechanism.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates material fold and template senses under the focus deception root. It remains anchored in that root and is sharpened by the context's copied record of intentional acts. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 7 can carry a material analogy in which repeated conduct takes a durable fold or governing pattern.

changed_reading.after: Worldly orientation repeatedly folded conduct into a template, and judgment's record reproduced the resulting behavioral crease.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the adjacent context strongly favors fire as the literal antecedent of the no-exit pronoun. It remains thematically anchored in the focus's nearest feminine life-noun and the denied-exit branch. Downstream prose must preserve fire as the grammatical reading and offer inescapable near-life only as a secondary conceptual echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 8-9 name proximate life before word 12 denies extraction from a feminine enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Life as experienced benefit supplies the horizon that was treated as exhaustive.
Nearness supplies the enclosing horizon beyond which the deceived reading refused to look.
Movement from inside to outside supplies the denied transcendence of that horizon.

Burning fire identifies the literal enclosure and prevents the exploratory echo from displacing the local reading.

changed_reading.before: The no-exit pronoun points only to the fire named immediately before the focus.
changed_reading.after: Under the literal fire referent, the clause also echoes a trap: the proximate life they made exhaustive has become a conceptual horizon they cannot transcend.

strongest_changes: The life-and-death context turns generic worldly distraction into epistemic closure: a true renewal cycle is treated as all that exists.
The judgment sequence makes denied restoration post-record procedural finality rather than a first refusal to hear.
The ridicule relation reverses into enclosure, while the immediately preceding fire-abode resolves the literal source of non-extraction.
The repeated sign vocabulary broadens the focus from mockery of one message to suppression of visible, recited, and forensic evidence channels.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms rather than one synthesis: semiotic repurposing, rival allegiance, perceptual foreground capture, closed-world explanation, procedural finality, reciprocal neglect, and a spatial reversal in which mocked evidence becomes enclosing consequence. Remote material branches also preserved vehicle and crease analogies without promoting them to translations.
remaining_uncertainties: Taking-as-mockery may be a shared rival-allegiance mechanism or simply one active misuse among several parallel offenses.
The arrows from proximity to attention capture and from ridicule to enclosure are reader-supplied, although the packet's sequences visibly support them.
The missing ع ت ب inventory prevents branch-level discrimination among apology, appeasement, and restored acceptance; only morphology and coordination support that side of the closure models.
The near-life no-exit reading is thematic only; the adjacent fire-abode remains the strong literal antecedent.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A shining appearance that cannot hold.** `غ ر ر/B008` is deception by an attractive but false appearance, while `د ن و` in `الدنيا` keeps the fixed ayah's attention on the nearer life. The packet contrasts the near life's persuasive surface with the now-present "today." I infer that temporal nearness was mistaken for ontological completeness. The ayah reads as exposure of a horizon error: what was closest to perception displaced what would prove stable.
2. **No crossing outward and no relational repair.** `خ ر ج/B001` is passing out from within, and `ع ت ب/B006` is return that appeases an offended party. The paired negatives close both a spatial route and a social-legal route. The packet supplies those closures; I infer that earlier ridicule destroyed not only correct belief but the conditions for restored relation. Judgment is final here because neither relocation nor appeasing revision remains available.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The praise and greatness of 45:36-37 replace the false scale that deceived them: the near life is no longer the frame within which value is assigned.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Near life deceives by presenting a bright surface as the whole scale.** Lexical anchors: deception by misleading appearance in `غ ر ر B008`, visible brightness in `غ ر ر B003`, life as benefit in `ح ي ي B013`, and the nearer/lower side in `د ن و B002`. The packet supplies manifest victory in 45:30, exposed works in 45:33, and universal scale in 45:36-37. I infer attractive near surface -> totalized valuation -> mockery of signs pointing beyond it. `غَرَّتْكُم` is a perceptual scaling error, not mere enjoyment of life.
2. **The two outcomes are opposed entrance systems.** Lexical anchors: passing out from within in `خ ر ج B001` under negation and returning to appease the reproacher in `ع ت ب B006`, also negated. The packet supplies entry into mercy in 45:30 and fire as gathering shelter in 45:34. I infer chosen trajectory -> enclosing destination; on this side neither release nor restorative return remains operative. The negated verbs make permanence procedural: no outward passage and no reopening of the relationship through appeasement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:36-37 supplied the missing scale correction: the nearer life's misleading brightness is bounded by lordship and greatness across sky and earth. The closing pair made `غَرَّتْكُم` read as a valuation error produced by mistaking a near surface for the whole.

baseline.text: Bu, Allah'ın ayetlerini alaya almanız ve dünya hayatının sizi aldatması yüzündendir. Bugün oradan çıkarılmayacaklar ve kendilerine bir telafi fırsatı verilmeyecektir.

findings.text: Dünya hayatı, yakın ve parlak yüzeyini bütün değer ölçüsü gibi göstererek algısal bir ölçek hatası üretir; yakın olan, kalıcı ve eksiksiz olan sanılır.
Çıkarılmama ile telafi fırsatının verilmemesi, hem dışarıya uzanan mekânsal yolu hem de ilişkiyi onaracak dönüş yolunu kapatır; kalıcılık bu iki işlemin birlikte durmasıyla oluşur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Judgment assigns bodies and collectives a posture, then places them within opposed enclosures from which the final condition is experienced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy takes on the enclosing and generative form of a womb, while fire is named as a shelter whose defining feature is compulsory residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fire Is a Refuge Without Exit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A place ordinarily defined by gathering and shelter becomes a compulsory fiery lodging with neither extraction nor assisting party.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: refuge that gathers its occupants (`quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); passage to the outside (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); aid against an enemy (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); pronounced statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `مأوى` retains the form of a place that receives and gathers, but its protective function is reversed. Fire occupies the shelter, the outward route is closed, and no external helper can alter the enclosure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A neglected meeting becomes reciprocal abandonment, after which neither explanation, changed route, nor appeasement can reopen the relation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Forgetting progresses from mental lapse to deliberate discarding, while rejected appeasement includes both relational repair and the attempt to take another road.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: No Route Returns to Satisfaction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Reproach would normally invite a change that restores satisfaction, but both the repaired relation and the alternate route are denied.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reproach voiced from displeasure (`quranic:root_000977:B005/m01`); return that satisfies the reproacher (`quranic:root_000977:B006/m01`); turning from one road to another (`quranic:root_000977:B007/m01`); passage to the outside (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); pronounced statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `يستعتبون` contains a complete repair script: fault is named, the offender changes course, and satisfaction returns. Its negation closes both the interpersonal process and the spatial alternative, matching the simultaneous denial of exit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Surfaces That Conceal and Then Encircle (P3: 45:27-37)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A bright or attractive surface can hide its outcome, but concealed action later crosses into visibility and surrounds its actor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The world's deceptive sheen and the later appearance of deeds are inverse phases of one visibility process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Near World's Gleam Conceals Risk
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A bright, choice-looking surface draws the inexperienced observer toward a proximate benefit while hiding an uncertain and hazardous outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: conspicuous brightness like a white blaze (`quranic:root_001078:B003/m01`); deception by what shines without stability (`quranic:root_001078:B008/m01`); hazard with an unknown outcome (`quranic:root_001078:B009/m01`); nearness and approach (`quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`); the near or lower world (`quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`); life construed as present benefit (`quranic:root_000383:B013/m01`); ridicule (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Nearness makes the benefit easy to grasp, while brilliance supplies the misleading signal. The mockery of signs belongs to the same surface judgment: what looks immediately light or advantageous displaces attention from the concealed outcome.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi edinme alanına almayı, ona erişip onu toplamayı ve ele geçirmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir.
